Uma Krishnan is a Full-Stack Developer at NovaGame Studios, where she balances backend complexity with frontend polish in a fast-paced gaming environment.  

Her AWS setup for the game analytics dashboard cut cloud costs by 30% through Terraform automation, while her CI/CD pipelines (Docker + Kubernetes) slashed deployment time by 40%. She debugged a critical Redis latency issue during a live event, avoiding a potential $20k revenue loss.  

Uma’s React components for the in-game marketplace saw a 25% load speed improvement via TypeScript and Web performance tweaks. She also built a Python-MongoDB pipeline that processed 10k+ daily user actions without downtime. Her REST API design for the lobby system integrated smoothly with Unity, reducing cross-team onboarding time.  

She’s reliable, communicative, and relentlessly detail-oriented—once she identified a 15% GPU utilization gap in our dev servers, she refactored the Node.js backend to balance workloads across 50+ microservices.  

Uma’s technical depth and problem-solving grit make her a solid asset for any team.
